Class ServletRegistrationBean<T extends Servlet>

java.lang.Object
org.springframework.boot.web.servlet.RegistrationBean
org.springframework.boot.web.servlet.DynamicRegistrationBean<ServletRegistration.Dynamic>
org.springframework.boot.web.servlet.ServletRegistrationBean<T>
Type Parameters:
T - 要注册的 Servlet 的类型
All Implemented Interfaces:
Aware, BeanNameAware, ServletContextInitializer, Ordered
Direct Known Subclasses:
DispatcherServletRegistrationBean
public class ServletRegistrationBean<T extends Servlet> extends DynamicRegistrationBean<ServletRegistration.Dynamic>
A ServletContextInitializer to register Servlets in a Servlet 3.0+ container. Similar to the registration features provided by ServletContext but with a Spring Bean friendly design.

在调用 RegistrationBean.onStartup(ServletContext) 之前，必须指定 servlet。URL 映射可以通过使用 setUrlMappings(Collection) 进行配置，或者在映射到 '/*' 时省略（除非将 alwaysMapUrl 设置为 false）。如果未指定 servlet 名称，则会自动推导。

Since:
1.4.0
Author:
Phillip Webb
